segment.source: Renders a slim single-row bar of shortcuts, each one an icon and two or three words, wrapping onto a second line only on narrow screens. Use it for: the three or four things people came to a page to do, the forms and phone numbers on a service page, jump-offs directly under a page title. Prefer 'Link Grid' when there are more than about six, and 'Anchor Bar' when the targets are sections of the page itself.
